integrity: The unbounded proof uses the first three divisors of an even integer, a four-divisor bound when divisible by \(4\), a sharp comparison for \(p=5\), and a factorization argument showing \(4\mid\sigma(m)\) when \(m\equiv3\pmod4\). The finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Only distinct-prime semiprimes are classified structurally. The \(p=2\) congruence is necessary rather than sufficient; no claim excludes that branch or settles the infinitude of \(p=3\) solutions.
title: An exact semiprime support sieve for the average-divisor increment equation
